flipToBack.prose: Flip if Galen or Vader is AT a battleground site AND opponent has NO unique character of ability > 3 AT a battleground site. Coded as AT (Filters.at), although printed text says 'present at' for the opponent clause.

children.req: presence-spot (includes excluded-from-battle): Galen or Vader AT a battleground site
presence-spot (includes excluded-from-battle): opponent's unique character of ability > 3 AT a battleground site

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent has a unique character of ability > 3 AT a battleground site, OR if NEITHER Vader NOR Galen can be spotted on table. The second route (Vader and Galen both gone) is NOT in the printed back game text - source adds it.

children.req: presence-spot (includes excluded-from-battle): opponent's unique character ability > 3 AT battleground site

requirementSemantics: Both flip laws are presence-SPOT checks (GameConditions.canSpot with Filters.at) - not control, not occupy, not 'present at' in the strict SWCCG sense: code uses Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site) even though the printed text says 'present at a battleground site'.

The flip is symmetric around one predicate: 'opponent has a unique character of ability > 3 at a battleground site' - absent flips front->back, present flips back->front. Rando must clear (or avoid) big unique enemy characters at battleground sites to flip and stay flipped.

SOURCE-vs-TEXT DIVERGENCE (back): printed back text has only the opponent-big-character flip-back; source adds an OR route flipping back when both Vader and Galen are off-table (Card601_087_BACK.java:112-113).
No place-out-of-play condition on either side.
This is a LEGACY (Block 4) virtual card: setAsLegacy(true), Icon.LEGACY_BLOCK_4, setVirtualSuffix(true) on both sides.
typedIdentities: Filters.Galen, Filters.Vader (personas; front flip actors; their joint absence flips the back to front)
Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.unique, Filters.character, Filters.abilityMoreThan(3), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)) (the pivot predicate both directions)
Filters.battleground_site (location class in every flip leaf)
Setup: Filters.Coruscant_system, Filters.Imperial_City, Filters.title(Title.A_Siths_Plans); optional Filters.If_The_Trace_Was_Correct (0-1)
Play ban (both sides, per-side modifier): Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.Dark_Jedi)

Persona.GALENS_LIGHTSABER, Persona.VADERS_LIGHTSABER (hit-tracking triggers, both sides): TriggerConditions.justHitBy(Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.character), Filters.or(...)) then leaves-table same turn -> opponent loses 2 Force
Front: ImmunityToAttritionChangeModifier(Filters.Galen, TrueCondition, MultiplyEvaluator(2, PresentWhereAffectedCardIsAtEvaluator(self, Filters.Jedi))) - Galen ITA +2 per Jedi present at his location
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Coruscant system (Card601_087.java:63), Imperial City (70), A Sith's Plans (77). OPTIONAL (0-1): If The Trace Was Correct (84-88).

FRONT: may take Rogue Shadow into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle - NOTE: no once-per-turn/phase usage limit is coded; the only guard is GameConditions.canTakeCardsIntoHandFromReserveDeck (Card601_087.java:93-107, GameTextActionId.LEGACY__HUNT_DOWN_V__UPLOAD_ROGUE_SHADOW).

BACK: once during your control phase, use 2 Force to take any one card WITHOUT ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card601_087_BACK.java:86-100, GameTextActionId.LEGACY__THEIR_FIRE_HAS_GONE_OUT_OF_THE_UNIVERSE_V__UPLOAD_CARD).
BACK: once during your control phase, retrieve 1 Force (requires non-empty Lost Pile) (Card601_087_BACK.java:74-84).
otherObligations: BOTH SIDES: may not deploy (MayNotPlayModifier) [Episode I] Dark Jedi (front Card601_087.java:112; back Card601_087_BACK.java:61).

BOTH SIDES: whenever an opponent character hit by Galen's Lightsaber or Vader's Lightsaber leaves table (same turn, via until-end-of-turn action proxy), opponent loses 2 Force (front Card601_087.java:137-175; back Card601_087_BACK.java:125-163).
FRONT: Galen's immunity to attrition +2 for each Jedi present where he is (Card601_087.java:113).
BACK: opponent's Force drain bonuses canceled; your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled (Card601_087_BACK.java:63-64).

BACK NOT IMPLEMENTED (source fact): '+2 to destiny draw if targeting a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin's Orders, or There Is No Conflict' exists only as a TODO comment (Card601_087_BACK.java:65) - no modifier is coded.

Rando obligations: keep Galen and/or Vader parked at battleground sites; hunt down opponent's unique ability>3 characters at battleground sites (their mere presence at any battleground site reverts the objective); use the lightsabers for hit-then-dies 2-Force bleed.
